def test_live_fetch_records_redirect_final_url_and_response_metadata(self) -> None:
        prepared = fetch_web_snapshot(f"{self.base_url}/redirect", timeout_seconds=3)
        provenance = prepared.provenance
        self.assertEqual(provenance["acquisition_mode"], "live-url-fetch")
        self.assertEqual(provenance["network_access"], "explicit")
        self.assertEqual(provenance["requested_url"], f"{self.base_url}/redirect")
        self.assertEqual(provenance["final_url"], f"{self.base_url}/article")
        self.assertEqual(provenance["status_code"], 200)
        self.assertEqual(len(provenance["redirect_chain"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(provenance["redirect_chain"][0]["status_code"], 302)
        self.assertEqual(provenance["response_headers"]["etag"], ['"fixture-v1"'])
        self.assertIn("set-cookie", provenance["omitted_response_headers"])

def test_live_fetch_rejects_non_html_timeout_oversize_and_network_unavailable(self) -> None:
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(WebSnapshotError, "must be HTML"):
            fetch_web_snapshot(f"{self.base_url}/json", timeout_seconds=3)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(WebSnapshotError, "exceeds max_response_bytes"):
            fetch_web_snapshot(f"{self.base_url}/large", timeout_seconds=3, max_response_bytes=256)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(WebSnapshotError, "timed out"):
            fetch_web_snapshot(f"{self.base_url}/slow", timeout_seconds=1)

        class _UnavailableOpener:
            def open(self, *_args: object, **_kwargs: object) -> object:
                raise URLError(OSError("fixture network unavailable"))

        with patch("ckb_core.reference_inputs.build_opener", return_value=_UnavailableOpener()):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(WebSnapshotError, "network request failed"):
                fetch_web_snapshot("http://127.0.0.1:9/unavailable", timeout_seconds=1)

def open(self, *_args: object, **_kwargs: object) -> object:
                raise URLError(OSError("fixture network unavailable"))

class WebReferenceEndToEndTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ckb-web-e2e-")
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.repo = make_repo(self.root)
        self.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), _FixtureHandler)
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()
        self.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.server.server_port}"

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.server.shutdown()
        self.server.server_close()
        self.thread.join(timeout=2)
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def _completed_output(self) -> Path:
        output = self.root / "output"
        initialized = invoke("init", "--repo", str(self.repo), "--out", str(output), "--format", "markdown")
        self.assertEqual(initialized.returncode, 0, initialized.stderr)
        review_all(output)
        merged = invoke("merge", "--out", str(output))
        self.assertEqual(merged.returncode, 0, merged.stderr)
        finalized = invoke("finalize", "--out", str(output))
        self.assertEqual(finalized.returncode, 0, finalized.stderr)
        return output

    def _static_ingest(self, output: Path, snapshot: Path, *extra: str, title: str = "网页快照资料", final_url: str = "https://example.test/article"):
        return invoke(
            "reference", "web-snapshot",
            "--out", str(output),
            "--snapshot", str(snapshot),
            "--source-root", str(self.root),
            "--requested-url", "https://example.test/start",
            "--final-url", final_url,
            "--retrieved-at", "2026-09-05T01:02:03Z",
            "--status-code", "200",
            "--content-type", "text/html; charset=utf-8",
            "--response-header", 'ETag:"fixture-v1"',
            "--title", title,
            "--origin", "显式提供的静态 HTTP 快照",
            "--license", "CC0-1.0",
            *extra,
        )

    def test_static_ingest_review_drift_duplicate_audit_and_rollback(self) -> None:
        output = self._completed_output()
        snapshot = self.root / "snapshot.html"
        snapshot.write_text(HTML, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

        ingested = self._static_ingest(output, snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(ingested.returncode, 4, ingested.stderr)
        result = json.loads(ingested.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "pending-agent-review")
        self.assertEqual(result["acquisition_mode"], "provided-static-snapshot")
        self.assertEqual(result["final_url"], "https://example.test/article")
        self.assertFalse((output / "human/references/网页快照资料.md").exists())

        manifest = json.loads(Path(result["manifest"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        extraction = json.loads(Path(manifest["extraction_file"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(manifest["input_adapter"], "web-snapshot-v1")
        self.assertEqual(manifest["source_sha256"], result["raw_snapshot_sha256"])
        self.assertEqual(manifest["body_snapshot_sha256"], result["body_snapshot_sha256"])
        self.assertEqual(manifest["web_capture"]["response_headers"]["etag"], ['"fixture-v1"'])
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(extraction["excluded_regions"]), 4)

        repeated = self._static_ingest(output, snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(repeated.returncode, 4, repeated.stderr)
        repeated_result = json.loads(repeated.stdout)
        self.assertTrue(repeated_result["idempotent"])
        self.assertEqual(repeated_result["reference_id"], result["reference_id"])

        review = json.loads(Path(result["review_template"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        paragraph = next(item for item in extraction["fragments"] if item["structure"] == "p")
        start = paragraph["source_range"]["start_line"]
        end = paragraph["source_range"]["end_line"]
        archived_lines = Path(result["source"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        review.update(
            {
                "status": "agent-reviewed",
                "summary_zh": "该网页快照记录许可可追溯的静态正文，并保留精确来源行范围。",
                "claims": [
                    {
                        "claim_zh": "归档正文明确说明结论可以通过 HTML 行范围复核。",
                        "fragment_id": paragraph["fragment_id"],
                        "start_line": start,
                        "end_line": end,
                        "source_text": "\n".join(archived_lines[start - 1 : end]),
                        "evidence_note": "已重新打开归档 HTML，并核对正文片段及其精确行范围。",
                    }
                ],
            }
        )
        review_path = self.root / "web-review.json"
        review_path.write_text(json.dumps(review, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        reviewed = invoke("reference", "review", "--out", str(output), "--review", str(review_path))
        self.assertEqual(reviewed.returncode, 0, reviewed.stderr)
        human = output / "human/references/网页快照资料.md"
        human_text = human.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("[最终 URL](https://example.test/article)", human_text)
        self.assertIn(f"原文第 {start} 行", human_text)
        self.assertIn("获取时间：2026-09-05T01:02:03Z", human_text)

        connection = sqlite3.connect(output / "machine/knowledge.sqlite")
        try:
            indexed = "\n".join(row[0] for row in connection.execute(
                "SELECT content FROM sections WHERE document_id=? ORDER BY start_line",
                (f"reference:{result['reference_id']}",),
            ))
        finally:
            connection.close()
        self.assertIn("正文结论可由归档 HTML", indexed)
        self.assertNotIn("导航噪声", indexed)
        self.assertNotIn("window.secret", indexed)

        drifted = self.root / "snapshot-drifted.html"
        drifted.write_text(HTML.replace("正文结论", "漂移后的正文结论"), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        rejected_drift = self._static_ingest(output, drifted)
        self.assertEqual(rejected_drift.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn("snapshot drift detected", rejected_drift.stderr)
        revision = self._static_ingest(output, drifted, "--revision-of", result["reference_id"])
        self.assertEqual(revision.returncode, 4, revision.stderr)
        revision_result = json.loads(revision.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(revision_result["revision"], 2)
        self.assertNotEqual(revision_result["body_snapshot_sha256"], result["body_snapshot_sha256"])
        rolled_revision = invoke("reference", "rollback", "--out", str(output), "--reference", revision_result["reference_id"])
        self.assertEqual(rolled_revision.returncode, 0, rolled_revision.stderr)

        duplicate = self._static_ingest(
            output,
            snapshot,
            title="同内容不同地址资料",
            final_url="https://mirror.example.test/article",
        )
        self.assertEqual(duplicate.returncode, 4, duplicate.stderr)
        duplicate_result = json.loads(duplicate.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(duplicate_result["duplicate_content_of"], result["reference_id"])
        rolled_duplicate = invoke("reference", "rollback", "--out", str(output), "--reference", duplicate_result["reference_id"])
        self.assertEqual(rolled_duplicate.returncode, 0, rolled_duplicate.stderr)

        body_snapshot = Path(result["extraction"]["body_snapshot"])
        baseline_body = body_snapshot.read_bytes()
        body_snapshot.write_bytes(baseline_body + b"drift")
        drift_audit = invoke("reference", "audit", "--out", str(output))
        self.assertEqual(drift_audit.returncode, 5)
        self.assertIn("reference-web-body-drift", drift_audit.stdout)
        body_snapshot.write_bytes(baseline_body)
        repaired_audit = invoke("reference", "audit", "--out", str(output))
        self.assertEqual(repaired_audit.returncode, 0, repaired_audit.stderr)

        rolled = invoke("reference", "rollback", "--out", str(output), "--reference", result["reference_id"])
        self.assertEqual(rolled.returncode, 0, rolled.stderr)
        self.assertFalse(human.exists())

    def test_explicit_live_fetch_and_network_failure_leave_existing_references_unchanged(self) -> None:
        output = self._completed_output()
        fetched = invoke(
            "reference", "web-fetch",
            "--out", str(output),
            "--url", f"{self.base_url}/redirect",
            "--timeout-seconds", "3",
            "--title", "实时抓取网页资料",
            "--origin", "显式实时 URL 抓取",
            "--license", "CC0-1.0",
        )
        self.assertEqual(fetched.returncode, 4, fetched.stderr)
        result = json.loads(fetched.stdout)
        manifest = json.loads(Path(result["manifest"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(result["acquisition_mode"], "live-url-fetch")
        self.assertEqual(result["final_url"], f"{self.base_url}/article")
        self.assertEqual(manifest["web_capture"]["redirect_chain"][0]["status_code"], 302)
        self.assertEqual(manifest["status"], "pending-agent-review")
        self.assertFalse((output / "human/references/实时抓取网页资料.md").exists())

        reference_root = output / "references"
        before = {
            path.relative_to(reference_root).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for path in reference_root.rglob("*")
            if path.is_file()
        }
        with patch(
            "ckb_core.reference_documents.fetch_web_snapshot",
            side_effect=WebSnapshotError("fixture network unavailable"),
        ):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(WebSnapshotError, "network unavailable"):
                ingest_web_reference(
                    output,
                    "断网失败资料",
                    "显式实时 URL 抓取",
                    "CC0-1.0",
                    url="https://unavailable.example.test/article",
                )
        after = {
            path.relative_to(reference_root).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for path in reference_root.rglob("*")
            if path.is_file()
        }
        self.assertEqual(after, before)

        rolled = invoke("reference", "rollback", "--out", str(output), "--reference", result["reference_id"])
        self.assertEqual(rolled.returncode, 0, rolled.stderr)

class ScopeExtensionTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ckb-scope-extension-")
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        self.repo = self.root / "repo"
        self.output = self.root / "knowledge"
        self.staging = self.root / "staging"
        self.repo.mkdir()
        (self.repo / "app.py").write_text("def first(value):\n    return value + 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (self.repo / "extra.py").write_text("def second(value):\n    return value * 2\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (self.repo / "third.py").write_text("def third(value):\n    return value - 3\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (self.repo / "duplicate.py").write_text("def repeated():\n    return 1\n\ndef repeated():\n    return 2\n", encoding="utf-8")
        (self.repo / "ignored.txt").write_text("not tracked source", encoding="utf-8")
        git(self.repo, "init")
        git(self.repo, "config", "user.email", "fixture@example.invalid")
        git(self.repo, "config", "user.name", "Fixture")
        git(self.repo, "add", ".")
        git(self.repo, "commit", "-m", "scope fixture")
        self.old_provider = os.environ.get("CKB_TEST_PROVIDER")
        os.environ["CKB_TEST_PROVIDER"] = "deterministic-fixture"
        initialize(self.repo, self.output, "markdown", ["app.py"], ["python:app.py#first"], 0, "both", [])
        review_all(self.output)
        finalize(self.output)
        for vault in ("human", "markdown"):
            page = self.output / vault / "user" / "学习笔记一.md"
            page.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            page.write_text("# 学习笔记一\n\n这是必须按原字节保留的第一份学习笔记。\n", encoding="utf-8")
            page2 = self.output / vault / "user" / "学习笔记二.md"
            page2.write_text("# 学习笔记二\n\n这是必须按原字节保留的第二份学习笔记。\n", encoding="utf-8")

    def test_cli_brief_and_stdio_share_scope_offer_schema(self) -> None:
        environment = os.environ.copy()
        environment.update({"PYTHONUTF8": "1", "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8", "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"})
        question = "scopeofferxyz987654321 extra.py"
        compile_warning = {
            "kind": "compile-commands-unavailable",
            "language": "cpp",
            "file": "compile_commands.json",
            "precision": "bounded-approximate",
            "build_evidence": {"resolution": "fallback-no-evidence", "selected": None, "paths": []},
            "absence_inference_allowed": False,
            "message_zh": "未找到 compile_commands.json，语义提供器继续使用有界近似参数；未检出结果不等于源码事实不存在。",
        }
        provider = {
            "name": "clangd",
            "language": "cpp",
            "status": "passed",
            "precision": "bounded-approximate",
            "diagnostic_count": 0,
            "warnings": [compile_warning],
        }
        connection = sqlite3.connect(self.output / "machine/knowledge.sqlite")
        try:
            connection.execute(
                "INSERT INTO providers(name,language,status,precision,diagnostic_count,evidence_json) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                ("clangd", "cpp", "passed", "bounded-approximate", 0, json.dumps(provider, ensure_ascii=False)),
            )
            connection.commit()
        finally:
            connection.close()

        def invoke(command: str) -> dict:
            completed = subprocess.run(
                [
                    sys.executable,
                    "-X",
                    "utf8",
                    str(SKILL_ROOT / "scripts/ckb.py"),
                    command,
                    "--out",
                    str(self.output),
                    question,
                    "--budget",
                    "1200",
                    "--profile",
                    "fast",
                ],
                text=True,
                encoding="utf-8",
                errors="replace",
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                env=environment,
            )
            self.assertEqual(completed.returncode, 0, completed.stderr)
            return json.loads(completed.stdout)

        retrieved = invoke("retrieve")
        brief = invoke("brief")
        self.assertEqual(retrieved["status"], "passed", retrieved)
        self.assertEqual(brief["status"], "passed")
        self.assertEqual(retrieved["warnings"]["warning_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(retrieved["warnings"]["examples"][0]["kind"], "compile-commands-unavailable")
        self.assertEqual(brief["scope_extension_offer"], retrieved["scope_extension_offer"])
        self.assertEqual(brief["next"], "await-scope-extension-confirmation")

        destination = io.StringIO()
        serve_stdio(
            self.output,
            input_stream=io.StringIO(
                json.dumps({"id": "stdio-offer", "method": "retrieve", "question": question, "budget": 1200})
                + "\n"
            ),
            output_stream=destination,
        )
        response = json.loads(destination.getvalue())
        self.assertTrue(response["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(response["result"]["scope_extension_offer"], retrieved["scope_extension_offer"])
        offer = retrieved["scope_extension_offer"]
        self.assertEqual(offer["selector"]["value"], "python:extra.py#second")
        self.assertEqual(offer["reason"]["code"], "source-outside-current-scope")
        self.assertTrue(offer["requires_confirmation"])

    def test_audit_drift_and_rollback_failure_are_recoverable(self) -> None:
        origin = _tree_manifest(self.output)
        start_scope_extension(self.output, self.repo, self.staging, ["python:extra.py#second"], 0, "both")
        review_all(self.staging)
        plan_path = self.staging / "scope-extension/plan.json"
        plan = json.loads(plan_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        plan["review"]["delta_entity_ids"].append(plan["review"]["reused_entity_ids"][0])
        json_write(plan_path, plan)
        failed = audit_scope_extension(self.staging)
        self.assertEqual(failed["status"], "failed")
        self.assertFalse(next(item for item in failed["checks"] if item["name"] == "exact-delta-review-set")["passed"])
        plan["review"]["delta_entity_ids"].pop()
        json_write(plan_path, plan)
        self.assertEqual(audit_scope_extension(self.staging)["status"], "ready")
        concurrent = self.output / "concurrent-write.txt"
        concurrent.write_text("concurrent drift", encoding="utf-8")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(CkbError, "origin-drift"):
            cutover_scope_extension(self.staging)
        concurrent.unlink()
        cutover_scope_extension(self.staging)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(CkbError, "rollback-failed"):
            rollback_scope_extension(self.output, fault="after-modified-rename")
        self.assertNotEqual(_tree_manifest(self.output), origin)
        self.assertEqual(rollback_scope_extension(self.output)["status"], "rolled-back")
        self.assertEqual(_tree_manifest(self.output), origin)

    def test_sequential_extensions_form_an_unwindable_active_chain(self) -> None:
        self.add_preserved_layers()
        initial = _tree_manifest(self.output)

        first_started = start_scope_extension(
            self.output, self.repo, self.staging, ["python:extra.py#second"], 0, "both"
        )
        review_all(self.staging)
        self.assertEqual(audit_scope_extension(self.staging)["status"], "ready")
        first_cutover = cutover_scope_extension(self.staging)
        first_operation = first_started["operation_id"]
        self.assertEqual(first_cutover["parent_operation_id"], None)
        self.assertEqual(first_cutover["chain_depth"], 1)
        first_tree = _tree_manifest(self.output)

        second_staging = self.root / "staging-second"
        second_started = start_scope_extension(
            self.output, self.repo, second_staging, ["python:third.py#third"], 0, "both"
        )
        review_all(second_staging)
        self.assertEqual(audit_scope_extension(second_staging)["status"], "ready")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(CkbError, "cutover-failed"):
            cutover_scope_extension(second_staging, fault="after-backup-rename")
        self.assertEqual(_tree_manifest(self.output), first_tree)
        status_after_failure = extension_status(self.output)
        self.assertEqual(status_after_failure["active_operation_id"], first_operation)

        second_cutover = cutover_scope_extension(second_staging)
        second_operation = second_started["operation_id"]
        self.assertEqual(second_cutover["parent_operation_id"], first_operation)
        self.assertEqual(second_cutover["chain_depth"], 2)
        active = extension_status(self.output)
        self.assertEqual(active["active_operation_id"], second_operation)
        self.assertEqual(active["parent_operation_id"], first_operation)

        first_control_path = Path(first_cutover["control"])
        second_control = Path(second_cutover["control"])
        saved_first = json_load(first_control_path)
        saved_second = json_load(second_control)
        legacy_first = json.loads(json.dumps(saved_first))
        legacy_second = json.loads(json.dumps(saved_second))
        for value in (legacy_first, legacy_second):
            value.pop("parent_operation_id", None)
            value.pop("chain_depth", None)
        json_write(first_control_path, legacy_first)
        json_write(second_control, legacy_second)
        inferred = extension_status(self.output)
        self.assertEqual(inferred["active_operation_id"], second_operation)
        self.assertEqual(inferred["parent_operation_id"], first_operation)
        self.assertEqual(inferred["chain_depth"], 2)
        json_write(first_control_path, saved_first)
        json_write(second_control, saved_second)

        drifted = json.loads(json.dumps(saved_second))
        drifted["parent_operation_id"] = "scope-extension-missing-parent"
        json_write(second_control, drifted)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(CkbError, "control-record-drift"):
            extension_status(self.output)
        json_write(second_control, saved_second)

        duplicate_id = "scope-extension-duplicate-active"
        duplicate_path = self.output.parent / f".{self.output.name}.scope-extension-{duplicate_id}.json"
        duplicate = json.loads(json.dumps(saved_second))
        duplicate["operation_id"] = duplicate_id
        json_write(duplicate_path, duplicate)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(CkbError, "control-record-active-ambiguous"):
            extension_status(self.output)
        duplicate_path.unlink()

        second_rollback = rollback_scope_extension(self.output)
        self.assertEqual(second_rollback["operation_id"], second_operation)
        self.assertEqual(second_rollback["reactivated_operation_id"], first_operation)
        self.assertEqual(_tree_manifest(self.output), first_tree)
        reactivated = extension_status(self.output)
        self.assertEqual(reactivated["active_operation_id"], first_operation)
        connection = sqlite3.connect(self.output / "machine/knowledge.sqlite")
        try:
            self.assertEqual(connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM entities WHERE qualified_name='first'").fetchone()[0], 1)
            self.assertEqual(connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM entities WHERE qualified_name='second'").fetchone()[0], 1)
            self.assertEqual(connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM entities WHERE qualified_name='third'").fetchone()[0], 0)
            self.assertEqual(connection.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0], "ok")
            self.assertEqual(connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall(), [])
        finally:
            connection.close()
        compatibility = sqlite3.connect(self.output / "agent-index.sqlite")
        try:
            self.assertEqual(compatibility.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0], "ok")
            self.assertEqual(compatibility.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall(), [])
        finally:
            compatibility.close()

        first_rollback = rollback_scope_extension(self.output)
        self.assertEqual(first_rollback["operation_id"], first_operation)
        self.assertEqual(first_rollback["reactivated_operation_id"], None)
        self.assertEqual(_tree_manifest(self.output), initial)
        final_status = extension_status(self.output)
        self.assertEqual(final_status["status"], "rolled-back")
        self.assertEqual(final_status["active_operation_id"], None)
        repeated = rollback_scope_extension(self.output)
        self.assertTrue(repeated["idempotent"])
        self.assertEqual(repeated["operation_id"], first_operation)
